understanding: The parent change is a control-plane refactor: the action-evidence admission guard for normal-mode DONE must stop running from the early mode-transition script and instead run in driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 after planner status parsing and before the DONE gate. The safety child task is to allow that parent change only after bridge_self_canary evidence, operator authorization, driver.ps1 -SelfTest, smoke.ps1, and rollback notes.
summary: Make a surgical two-file relocation: remove the DONE rejection/force_coder action-evidence guard from driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1, keep 85 focused on turn bookkeeping/stagnation, and insert the guard in driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 immediately after status parse in the normal-mode DONE guard cluster before the full done-gate. The relocated block must initialize all local variables defensively, run only for an active normal DONE admission, and set force_coder only for a current missing-action-evidence rejection, preventing post-acceptance spurious rejections.

decision_atoms.statement: Relocate only the DONE-admission action-evidence guard, not unrelated mode-transition or stagnation logic.
decision_atoms.reason: The observed failure is caused by DONE admission being evaluated too early, before status-parse and normal DONE gate context are stable.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Leaves some evidence-related helper usage in earlier driver phases if it is genuinely for stagnation, but avoids a wider behavioral rewrite.

decision_atoms.statement: Place the relocated guard in driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 directly after plannerStatus status parsing and before full DONE-gate checks.
decision_atoms.reason: At that point plannerStatus, modeBeforeIncrement, speaker, fastLaneDone, and task state are available, while the final DONE gate has not yet executed.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: The guard becomes tightly coupled to completion-check ordering, so future status synthesis paths must be reviewed when added.

decision_atoms.statement: Initialize every guard-local value before try/catch use and treat helper failures as fail-closed CONTINUE with an explicit failure record.
decision_atoms.reason: This targets the property/variable-not-found class directly and preserves conservative DONE admission behavior.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: A real helper regression can still block DONE, but it will produce a controlled error instead of an unbound variable/property crash.

decision_atoms.statement: Only set force_coder when the current active normal backlog task is rejected for missing_action_evidence.
decision_atoms.reason: This prevents the next turn after an accepted DONE from being pushed back to coder by stale action-evidence state.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Other rejection reasons will rely on planner-visible failure messages rather than forced coder routing.

decision_atoms.statement: Use bridge_self_canary as a hard promotion gate for the parent control-plane edit.
decision_atoms.reason: The edited files drive task admission and completion; a bad ordering bug can affect every driver turn.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Slower rollout, but appropriate for high-risk control-plane code.

decision_atoms.statement: Require driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1 to pass on the patched canary before operator promotion.
decision_atoms.reason: The task contract explicitly requires both tests, and they cover driver integrity plus broader bridge smoke behavior.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: These checks may not prove the metric reduction alone, so they must be paired with targeted canary log evidence.

assumptions: The operator will provide explicit authorization after reviewing canary evidence and before promoting the parent change.
bridge_self_canary can run against an isolated channel or state snapshot without mutating production task state.

The existing helper lib/task-action-evidence.ps1 remains the source of Get-TaskActionEvidence, Get-TaskActionEvidenceContext, Get-TaskDoneEvidenceDecision, Test-TaskCoveredVerifiedDoneEvidence, and Test-TaskDoneQaPassCommitEvidence.
Existing dirty/untracked files are unrelated and must not be reverted or overwritten.
The metric claims will be validated from canary logs rather than inferred from tests alone.

risks.risk: Incorrect ordering relative to status parse, parallel-dispatch DONE synthesis, or done-gate could either skip the guard or reject valid DONE.
risks.mitigation: Add a focused canary scenario for normal DONE with evidence, normal DONE without evidence, fast-lane DONE, and post-accepted-DONE next turn; inspect logs before promotion.

risks.risk: Removing too much from driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 could weaken no-progress detection.
risks.mitigation: Move only DONE-admission behavior; keep or replace passive action detection separately if required by stagnation semantics.

risks.risk: force_coder may still be set from stale state after task closure.
risks.mitigation: Guard force_coder writes behind active current_task/current_backlog_id checks and only for missing_action_evidence on the current task.

risks.risk: Canary evidence may be incomplete if it only runs happy-path tests.
risks.mitigation: Require negative and recovery canary cases plus log assertions for zero property/variable-not-found and zero post-acceptance DONE rejection.

risks.risk: Rollback could be complicated by concurrent edits in the same driver files.
risks.mitigation: Record pre-change commit/diff, keep the patch limited to driver/85 and driver/86, and prepare a two-file git restore or revert command in rollback notes.

minimal_version: Patch driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 to remove the early action-evidence DONE-admission/rejection behavior and any force_coder writes tied to it. Patch driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 so the same admission decision runs after status parsing and before the full done-gate, with explicit defaults for all locals and active-task checks before force_coder. Canary sequence: run the patched driver in bridge_self_canary on an isolated channel; capture evidence for missing-evidence rejection, valid-evidence acceptance, and the next turn after accepted DONE; confirm no property/variable-not-found messages and no spurious DONE rejected/force_coder. Then run powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\driver.ps1 -SelfTest and powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\smoke.ps1. Promote only after operator authorization. Rollback notes: revert the patch commit or restore driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 and driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 from the pre-change commit, then rerun SelfTest/smoke.
advanced_version: In addition to the minimal relocation, extract the admission block into a small internal helper such as Invoke-DriverActionEvidenceDoneAdmission inside driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 or a shared driver-local helper, with structured return fields allow, reason, hasEvidence, and shouldForceCoder. Add regression fixtures or script-level tests covering uninitialized/missing state properties, project-repo base commits, covered-after-restart evidence, done-qa-pass commit evidence, fast-lane DONE, and post-closure next-turn behavior. Store canary artifacts under the channel decisions directory with the operator approval, commands, logs, metric checks, and rollback note path.
